caption:
Every task hitting your phone wants equal urgency.

Only one box actually deserves it.

Sort everything with two questions: is it time-sensitive, and does it move revenue.

01 Urgent + revenue: new lead calls and forms. Answer in minutes.
02 Revenue, not urgent: estimates and proposals. Block real calendar time.
03 Urgent, low revenue: reminders, review requests, missed-call replies. Automate these.
04 Neither: admin and internal noise. Batch it once a day.

Most owners spend the morning in box 04 and wonder why box 01 goes cold.

See your own leads sorted this way. 14 days free, no card.

DM TRIAL

rationale: Carousels still win saves and depth for B2B authority content, and this urgency-versus-revenue triage matrix is a genuinely unclaimed 2x2 decision framework distinct from every prior stage, ladder, decay-curve, tiering, and scorecard model already shipped.
